prompt: Social media is a good thing for modern society. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement.
essay:
Many people believe that social media is beneficial for our current society. I mostly disagree with this view because using these apps are slowly causing many problems, such as cyberbullying and reduced levels of attention spans; however, I understand that social media is also making long-distance communication much more efficient today.

One main reason why I believe that social media is having a bad influence on our society is that it has been leading to severe cases of online bullying. Today, anyone is able to post inappropriate images of others to make fun of them in cruel ways. To illustrate, a friend of mine once had their pictures posted on Instagram, and that image eventually gained a lot of hate and unkind comments. With issues like these becoming more prevalent, it can lead victims to feel depressed, embarrassed, or even suicidal.

In addition, social media reduces people's attention spans because, based on scientific research, frequently watching short clips will gradually make our brains more distracted. Consequently, it can lead to not being able to work or study productively, and therefore, work in our society may not always be at its best quality.

However, due to the advanced technology in these apps, people from distances as far as thousands of miles can communicate with each other faster and more easily. This is extremely helpful because it makes doing business from overseas and talking to our loved ones much less difficult.

In conclusion, I mostly believe that social media has a negative impact on our society because it could lead to health issues and effect peoples' work. This is because cyberbullying can result in depression, and habitually watching short clips will make attention spans shorter. However, I admit that social media has positive influences on our society as well, such as making communication with others easier. Given the situation, it is still better to use less social media, as serious issues could occur.
